exposure: Glucocorticoid (GC) dispensations before and/or during pregnancy
Hydroxychloroquine (HCQ) dispensations before and/or during pregnancy
cohort: The study included singleton pregnancies among women with Systemic Lupus Erythematosus and general population controls identified from the Swedish Medical Birth Register and Swedish Lupus Linkage cohort.
finding: When looking at all deliveries, Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE) was associated with a 2-fold higher risk of Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM), and GDM occurrence did not differ by Glucocorticoid (GC) or Hydroxychloroquine (HCQ) use.
